nodes.description: Caller-supplied address used for access control and ownership checks across all contracts
address public governor; set in constructor and mutated by setGovernor; controls onlyGovernor
bool public paused; gates pause/unpause and whenNotPaused functions
uint8 public currentSeason; incremented in nextSeason and stored into every ProtoCard
uint16 public protoCount; incremented on every proto card insertion
mapping(uint16 => Limit) public limits; mythic supply limits, decremented when a mythic card is created
mapping(uint8 => bool) seasonTradable; guards transfers and proto replacement
mapping(uint => address) owners; authoritative token ownership record (unchecked in _transfer)
mapping(address => uint40[]) public ownedTokens; per-owner token enumeration array
uint24[] indices; position of a token inside its owner's ownedTokens array
uint public burnCount; incremented by burn, subtracted in totalSupply
mapping(uint => address) approved; single-token approvals
mapping(address => mapping(address => bool)) operators; operator approvals
Card[] public cards; array of minted card instances, index is token id
CardPack[] packs; approved pack contracts allowed to mint cards
Purchase[] purchases; purchase records holding user, count, randomness and commit block
uint public totalCount; accumulated pack count mixed into randomness
bool public canClaim; owner-controlled switch gating claim
Vault/CappedVault instance that custodies purchase ETH
address public owner; owner of Vault/CappedVault/Pausable/TournamentPass
uint256 supply; total minted tournament passes
uint mintLimit = 20000; cap on mintable supply
address[] public minters; allow-list of addresses allowed to mint
uint withdrawn; total ETH already withdrawn from the capped vault
uint public limit = 33333 ether; cap on total() tracked balance
mapping(uint => string) uris; tokenURI storage
setGovernor(address _gov) onlyGovernor; writes governor state variable
pause() onlyGovernor whenNotPaused; sets paused = true
unpause() onlyGovernor whenPaused; sets paused = false
setLimit(uint16 id, uint64 limit) onlyGovernor; writes limits mapping once
nextSeason() onlyGovernor; increments uint8 currentSeason and clears rarity arrays
_addProto(uint16, ProtoCard, bool) internal; stores proto, increments protoCount, pushes to rarity arrays
getRandomCard(Rarity, uint16) view; pseudo-random selection using caller-supplied random value
replaceProto(...) onlyGovernor; rewrites a proto only when its season is not tradable
_transfer(address from, address to, uint id) internal; unchecked ownership mutation plus index bookkeeping
_create(address to, uint id) internal; assigns owner and registers token
_addToken(address to, uint id) private; pushes to ownedTokens and indices
_removeToken(address from, uint id) public payable; swap-and-pop enumeration, callable by anyone because visibility is public
transfer(address to, uint id) payable; checks ownership and tradability then calls _transfer
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint id) payable; approval based transfer
burn(uint id); increments burnCount and transfers token to address(0)
safeTransferFrom(address,address,uint,bytes) payable; performs transfer then calls onERC721Received on receiver
setApprovalForAll(address to, bool toApprove); writes operators mapping
createCard(address,uint16,uint16) whenNotPaused onlyApprovedPacks; mints a card and decrements mythic limits
_createCard(address owner, uint16 proto, uint16 purity) internal; pushes Card and calls _create
addPack(CardPack approved) onlyGovernor; appends to approved packs
purchase(uint16 packCount, address referrer) whenNotPaused payable; records purchase, pays referrer and vault
callback(uint id) public; derives randomness from blockhash(commit) and totalCount, anyone can call
claim(uint id) public; mints cards via integration.createCard and advances p.current
withdraw() onlyOwner; transfers whole balance to owner
getComponents(uint16,uint8,uint) internal; bit extraction and keccak based derived randomness
calculatePrice(uint base, uint16 packCount) view; time based discount derived from block.number
purchase(uint16,address) payable; calls super.purchase then mints TournamentPass tokens
getCardDetails(uint16,uint8,uint) view; rarity and purity derivation for pack openings
mint(address to, uint amount); minter-gated mint with mintLimit check
purchase(uint amount) payable; mints passes and forwards msg.value to vault
transfer(address,uint256); balance bookkeeping using SafeMath
transferFrom(address,address,uint256); allowance based transfer using SafeMath
withdraw(uint amount) onlyOwner; sends ETH to owner via transfer
withdraw(uint amount) onlyOwner; sends ETH to owner and increments withdrawn
SafeMath.mul with assert on overflow
SafeMath.add with assert on overflow
SafeMath.sub with assert on underflow
_isContract(address) internal view; uses inline assembly extcodesize
total() view; returns getBalance() + withdrawn used for the deposit cap
referrer.transfer(commission) sends ETH to a caller-controlled address inside PresalePack.purchase
address(vault).transfer(price) sends ETH to the vault contract inside PresalePack.purchase
owner.transfer(amount) ETH transfer performed by Vault/CappedVault withdraw
ERC721TokenReceiver(to).onERC721Received.gas(50000) external callback into an arbitrary contract
inline assembly extcodesize(test) used to distinguish contracts from EOAs
pass.mint(msg.sender, packCount) external call into the TournamentPass contract
address(vault).transfer(msg.value) external ETH transfer in TournamentPass.purchase
integration.createCard(user, proto, purity) external call from PresalePack.claim to the card integration
parameter packCount of PresalePack.purchase, controls price and number of packs
parameter referrer of PresalePack.purchase, arbitrary address receiving commission
local variable price of PresalePack.purchase, derived from basePrice and commission
parameter id of PresalePack.callback indexing the purchases array
local storage pointer p to purchases[id] in PresalePack.callback
parameter amount of Vault.withdraw
parameter _gov of Governable.setGovernor
parameter id of CardOwnership.transfer
parameter to of CardOwnership.transfer
local array ids in PresalePack.claim holding freshly minted card ids
local variable result in PresalePack.claim taken from p.randomness
parameter id of CardOwnership.burn
local memory struct card in CardIntegration.createCard loaded from protos[proto]

edges.reason: msg.sender is compared against governor in the onlyGovernor modifier
msg.sender is compared against owner in the onlyOwner modifier used by Vault, CappedVault, Pausable and TournamentPass
setGovernor is restricted by onlyGovernor which reads msg.sender
pause is restricted by onlyGovernor which reads msg.sender
unpause is restricted by onlyGovernor which reads msg.sender
nextSeason is restricted by onlyGovernor which reads msg.sender
transfer requires owns(msg.sender, id) before moving the token
transferFrom authorization path isSenderApprovedFor uses msg.sender, ownerOf and getApproved
burn requires owns(msg.sender, id)
msg.sender is stored as Purchase.user and checked against referrer
claim uses p.user as the mint recipient while the msg.sender ownership check is commented out
ShinyLegendaryPack.purchase forwards msg.sender to super.purchase and pass.mint
mint requires isMinter(msg.sender) over the minters allow-list
TournamentPass.purchase credits msg.sender balances and forwards msg.value
setApprovalForAll requires to != msg.sender and writes operators[msg.sender][to]
Vault.withdraw is gated by onlyOwner which reads msg.sender
CappedVault.withdraw is gated by onlyOwner which reads msg.sender
transfer delegates to the internal _transfer after its checks
transferFrom delegates to the internal _transfer
burn calls _transfer towards address(0)
safeTransferFrom first performs the plain transferFrom
_create registers the token via _addToken
_transfer adds the token to the recipient enumeration
_transfer removes the token from the sender enumeration
createCard delegates minting to _createCard
_createCard assigns ownership through _create
_createCard pushes a new Card into the cards array and uses its index as token id
createCard decrements limits[proto].limit with no SafeMath and only a limit > 0 guard when the limit exists
setLimit writes a one-shot entry into the limits mapping
setGovernor writes the governor state variable, allowing unilateral governor rotation
pause sets paused = true
unpause sets paused = false
currentSeason is a uint8 incremented after require(currentSeason <= 255) so 255 wraps to 0
protoCount is a uint16 incremented without SafeMath in _addProto
_addProto stores protos and pushes the external id into the matching rarity array
_addProto copies the current season into the newly created proto card
_addToken pushes the token id into ownedTokens[to]
_addToken records the position into the global indices array
_removeToken swap-and-pops an element out of ownedTokens[from]
_removeToken reads indices[id] to locate the element inside ownedTokens
claim calls integration.createCard for every card in the opened pack
claim performs an external call into the integration contract for each minted card
getCardDetails derives its randomness components through getComponents
getCardDetails asks the integration contract for a random proto by rarity
ShinyLegendaryPack.purchase invokes the inherited PresalePack.purchase
After payment the pack contract performs an external call to pass.mint, an outside contract that could re-enter
PresalePack.purchase sends ETH to an arbitrary caller-supplied referrer address with transfer
PresalePack.purchase forwards the remaining price to the vault with transfer after the purchase record is written
Vault.withdraw sends ETH to owner with transfer, an external call with no reentrancy guard
CappedVault.withdraw sends ETH to owner with transfer and only then increments withdrawn
safeTransferFrom calls onERC721Received on an arbitrary receiver contract with 50k gas after the state change
_isContract uses inline assembly extcodesize to decide whether to call the receiver hook
TournamentPass.purchase forwards msg.value to the vault through an external transfer
TournamentPass.purchase reads the vault address to forward the received ETH
PresalePack.purchase reads the vault address to forward the pack price
callback mixes and then increases totalCount when deriving randomness
callback writes p.randomness in the purchases array and can be invoked by anybody
claim requires canClaim which the owner can toggle
claim advances p.current in the purchases array
mint increases supply via SafeMath.add
mint compares amount.add(supply) against the mintLimit cap
mint iterates the minters array inside isMinter
TournamentPass.purchase increases supply when a pass is bought
TournamentPass.transfer uses SafeMath.add for the recipient balance
TournamentPass.transfer uses SafeMath.sub for the sender balance
transferFrom uses SafeMath.add for the recipient balance
transferFrom uses SafeMath.sub for balances and allowance
CappedVault.total adds the already withdrawn amount to the current balance for the cap check
replaceProto requires that the proto season is not tradable before rewriting it
setApprovalForAll writes the operators mapping for the caller
_transfer clears approved[id] when a token moves
_transfer writes owners[id] = to without validating the destination beyond the callers own checks
_create writes owners[id] = to for freshly minted tokens
burn increments burnCount with plain ++ and no SafeMath
purchase computes its price using calculatePrice(basePrice(), packCount)
packCount parameter drives the price calculation and pack counting
referrer parameter is compared to msg.sender and receives a commission
local price is the amount checked against msg.value and split between referrer and vault
callback id parameter selects the purchase record to finalize
local storage pointer p is the purchases entry being updated in callback
amount parameter is the ETH value forwarded to owner in Vault.withdraw
_gov parameter becomes the new governor state variable
id parameter is the token being transferred
to parameter is the recipient of the transfer
local ids array collects the minted card ids emitted in PackOpened
local result is the stored randomness from the callback used to derive cards
id parameter is the token being burned
local card struct caches protos[proto] for the season and rarity checks

referrer is an unvalidated external address used for the commission transfer inside purchase
local price aggregates basePrice and commission and is used for the msg.value check and vault payout
id only indexes the purchases array inside callback
storage pointer p aliases purchases[id] and is mutated only inside callback
amount is the ETH quantity forwarded to owner by Vault.withdraw
_gov is the new governor address written by setGovernor
id identifies the token moved by transfer
to is the recipient validated against address(0) by transfer
ids is a scratch buffer filled and emitted only within claim
result is the randomness value consumed only inside claim
id is the token destroyed by burn after the ownership check
card is a transient copy of protos[proto] used only for the season and rarity checks in createCard
